notes.title: Farming Simulator 22 releases November 22nd.
notes.content:
[b]Release-Date and Trailer for Farming Simulator 22 - pre-order now![/b]


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248130/LandwirtschaftsSimulator_22/]Farming Simulator 22[/url] releases November 22nd, and you can pre-order now! Get the CLAAS XERION SADDLE TRAC Pack if you do. Also, if you want so secure yourself a limited PC Collector's Edition including a working beacon light and many other bonuses, you should not waste any time. It's only available while stocks last!

To celebrate the release date, there's also our first cinematic trailer. You can watch it below to get an atmospheric taste of the game. 

[b]
"It's a calling" - so, let the good times grow![/b]


[previewyoutube=tgv3RzTaxQM;full][/previewyoutube]

As new generations of farmers grow into the footsteps of their parents - in real-life or by the joy of playing Farming Simulator - we see our two protagonists, father and daughter, working the field together. Whether you play by yourself or together in multiplayer mode, the rewarding victory of harvested grapes will be worth it. Apropos grapes, want to know more about the new crops in Farming Simulator 22? We take a first look at our new crops, too. 


[b][h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248130/LandwirtschaftsSimulator_22/]Pre-order now to get the CLAAS XERION SADDLE TRAC Pack![/url][/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25636483/f94543bb84c5ae3c3160c3e6fcb7b292ec170011.png[/img]

Farming Simulator 22 releases for PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Stadia on November 22nd. All pre-orders receive the CLAAS XERION SADDLE TRAC Pack to enjoy the CLAAS XERION 4200 SADDLE TRAC plus four more machines by KAWECO. Find the complete list of items below!

[b]CLAAS XERION SADDLE TRAC Pack[/b]

[list]
[*] CLAAS XERION 4200 SADDLE TRAC
[*] KAWECO XERION SADDLE TRAC Tanker
[*] KAWECO XERION SADDLE TRAC Semi-Trailed Tanker
[*] KAWECO OPTI-JECT 800
[*] KAWECO Front-Unit
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25636483/c7103fd70bebb6acf8f5a2f67cfc18f02dcc7282.jpg[/img]


Interested in the limited Collector's Edition for PC? It includes a working beacon light: Plugged in via USB, responds to the beacon lights in-game as soon as you turn them on in Farming Simulator 22. Also included are new modding tutorials, brand stickers and posters.

notes.title: ROPA DLC & Official Expansion 2 available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25636483/d95bc05cc0ff4429eb705bb2fec7e7d60e2efec3.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Today, Farming Simulator 17 gets bigger and adds a new vehicle brand - ROPA - to its long list of famous farming constructors![/b]

ROPA DLC comes with new impressive vehicles and equipment that will help you expand your farm and bring sugar beet and potato harvesting to a whole new level.

This DLC is available today for download. The ROPA DLC is also included in the Season Pass offer on consoles.
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25636483/a4fc437c39cbfca007efeb9f85870803cfdf6a9d.jpg[/img]
 
ROPA DLC is also part of the brand new Official Expansion 2 for Farming Simulator 17 releasing today for retail on PC. 

The Official Expansion 2 gathers all the DLCs released to date for the game, bringing an incredible amount of new brands, adding 35+ vehicles and equipment tools to your Farming Simulator 17: 
[list][*]ROPA DLC
[*]Big Bud DLC
[*]KUHN DLC[/list]
Players eager to create and add new content to the game will also be pleased to discover it also includes the PDF versions of the Official e-books 'Farming Simulator Modding For Dummies' and ‘The Art of Modding’.
Also discover a Behind the Scenes video of the making of Farming Simulator 17 and a series of tutorial videos about modding.
 
[b]The ROPA DLC is now available for download on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC. 

The Official Expansion 2 for Farming Simulator 17 is now available in retail on PC.[/b]

notes.title: From Seeds To Harvest
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/30/1469700915-fs17-sunflower-gif-2.gif[/img]

[h1][b]The first Farming Simulator 17 Gameplay Trailer has arrived![/b][/h1]

Today's trailer, [b]From Seeds to Harvest[/b], is the first in a series of gameplay videos where we will be showing the new content and features of Farming Simulator 17! 

In this first gameplay video, you'll discover the basics of farming one of the [b]new crops, sunflowers, using the latest brands, vehicles, and equipment in Farming Simulator 17![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CaTbIhx5Cck

Farming Simulator is an accurate simulator at heart with deep management options, but also a very accessible sandbox, with two huge maps and countless vehicles & equipment to use and play with. 

All the big farming manufacturers are here, and Farming Simulator 17 boasts the franchise's largest roster yet with [b]over 200 unique vehicles[/b] and equipment spanning [b]70 different brands[/b]! For the first time in Farming Simulator history, [b]AGCO brands Challenger, Fendt, Valtra, and Massey Ferguson are available![/b]

Among the many new features to be announced in the coming months for Farming Simulator 17, we are happy to unveil that modding support - which is exceptionally popular on PC - is making its grand debut on consoles! With Farming Simulator 17, all the players will be able to download content created by the passionate community of Farming Simulator players, including vehicles, animals, scenery elements and much more, opening up the possibilities of an ever-evolving Farming Simulator 17 experience. 

[h1][b]Farming Simulator 17 will be available on October 25th on PS4, Xbox One, and PC.[/b][/h1]
